correctness.rationale: Polarity yields K°=conv(Bq^d,±e1/a). Exact polar cone tangent at s=a^(p-1) gives product 4κp,mκq,m F(a)H(a); direct calculus gives F'=v^(m/p), H'=-v^(m/q)/(d a²). Sign of derivative reduces to W, and W' has positive prefactor times [T(a^p)-m(2-p)/2], with T decreasing strictly m to 0; endpoint signs prove unique maximum for 1<p<2 and strict monotonicity for p>=2. Independent numeric derivative, polar-section and d3,p2 polynomial checks corroborated analytic proof.
